title: Customer Implementation Tracker (milestone + owners) - template
description: Lightweight implementation tracker for inference rollouts. Designed as a living spreadsheet teams can copy per-customer. Focuses on discrete milestones, single-point owners, explicit blockers, and next-step actions so CS/SE/solutions teams can run to an agreed cutover and renewal signals.
purpose: Provide a concise, shareable status sheet that can be attached to QBRs and renewal discussions. Meant for operational use during onboarding and large feature rollouts (hosted/dedicated/private).
update_frequency: Weekly (update by owner before Monday sync)
columns: Current status (not started / in progress / blocked / done)
sample_rows: EdgeHealth, EH-2024-07, Clinical triage embeddings, Model validation complete, Marcus Li, 2024-06-28, done, 100, none, , None, , infra QA signoff required, peer review, Level 1

FinLease, FL-2024-02, Document ingestion + rerank, Daniel Park, 2024-07-15, in progress, 65, slow S3 transfer from customer, Customer IT, Increase parallel workers, Solutions Eng, network access ticket CS-4721, Level 2, Customer must whitelist Redwood IPs

RetailCo, RC-2024-09, Latency SLO tuning, Sofia Martinez, 2024-08-01, blocked, 20, inability to reproduce tail latency, SRE, Run controlled repro with sample traffic, SRE, needs test dataset, Level 3, Awaiting log access
milestones_checklist: Kickoff / scoping call (define SLOs, data paths, security requirements)
Access provisioning (VPC peering, S3 role, KMS/HSM setup)
Renewal / ROI check-in (60 days prior to renewal)
owners_matrix_notes: Assign 1 owner per milestone. Owners should be a named individual (not just team). For cross-functional blockers, set blocker owner as the person responsible to resolve or escalate. If unresolved after 3 business days, escalation to Level 2 (CS lead) is required.
common_blockers: Missing data export or schema mismatch
Customer time constraints for validation windows
Incompatible model variant for latency/cost targets
Lack of test traffic to reproduce issues
blocker_triage_steps: 1) Owner documents symptoms and minimal repro steps in tracker
2) Owner notifies assigned blocker owner and posts summary in customer channel
3) If blocker persists >72 hours, tag as escalation Level 2 and assign CS lead
4) For infra or SRE issues, create triage ticket with logs and target SLA
5) Track progress in tracker and surface in weekly QBR digest
escalation_playbook: Level 1 (owner-level): resolve within 3 business days — owner to propose mitigation
Level 2 (CS lead): involve Solutions Engineering and SRE — target 48-hour response
Level 3 (Exec escalation): involve VP CS and Sales — used for contract-impacting outages or >5 business day unresolved core blockers
dashboard_guidance: Color-code rows by status (green=done, yellow=in progress, red=blocked). Add a lightweight formula for percent complete (owner reported). Keep the top of the sheet for 3-5 active items for exec view; archive older milestones to a separate tab. Attach test logs and run artifacts via linked_artifacts entries.
qbr_notes_snippet: Suggested QBR blurb: 'Implementation is at X%. Key upcoming milestones: [milestone list]. Principal blocker: [short blocker], owner: [name], mitigation: [plan]. Expected cutover: [date].' Keep a single-row summary for executive slides.
privacy_and_security_flagging: Column for 'Hosted / Dedicated / Private' and an explicit 'PHI/PII present' yes/no field. If PHI/PII present, add mandatory 'security review completed' milestone before canary.
how_to_copy_template: Make a copy of this sheet per-customer, rename to '<Customer> - Implementation tracker', update Engagement ID, owners and dates. Link the sheet in the customer record and the renewal tracker. Maintain change log in sheet comments.
recommended_workflow: CS owns weekly updates; Solutions Eng owns performance milestones; SRE owns infra milestones; Customer success manager owns renewal signals and executive summary for QBRs
retention_and_archiving: After project closeout, move the file to confluence or archive folder and copy key metrics into the renewal tracker. Keep archives for 12 months for auditability.
